title: Orion private deployment weekly sync - 2026-07-06
content:
Weekly sync notes / prep - Orion private deployment (VPC + on-prem)
Date: 2026-07-06
Owner: Ethan Zhang (Redwood)
Attendees: Lucia G., Marcus L., Zoe P., Samir P. (Orion), + infra oncall (zoom)

Goals for this meeting:
- Quick status across network, infra provisioning, security, app deploys
- Surface blockers that are blocking milestone 2 (DB migration + app canary)
- Assign owners + realistic due dates

Quick status snapshot (one-liners)
- Network / VPC: baseline VPC + subnets provisioned in prod region (us-west-2). Still missing egress NAT gateway rules for analytics cluster. (Owner: Marcus)
- VPN / Direct connect: BGP session partially established; AS path mismatch on Orion side causing intermittent route withdrawal. (Owner: Samir)
- Baremetal / on-prem provisioning: PXE images validated; IPMI creds rotated but automated power-cycle script failing on node-04. (Owner: Lucia)
- KMS / HSM: Key provisioning requested; waiting on Orion security for HSM cert import (security review). (Owner: Zoe)
- App deploy: CI builds green; helm chart tweak needed for KV cache persistence path. Canary planned after DB snapshot restore. (Owner: Ethan)

Milestones & timeline (reminder)
- Milestone 1: Network + infra baseline (DONE on 2026-06-25)
- Milestone 2: DB migration + app canary (target: 2026-07-10) <-- at risk
- Milestone 3: Full cutover + SLA handover (target: 2026-07-20)

Blockers (detailed)
1) BGP / route instability between Redwood VPC and Orion edge (high)
   - Symptom: intermittent route withdrawal, traffic to analytics cluster spikes latency
   - Temporary workaround: failover to backup region (manual) - not acceptable at scale
   - Next steps: Orion networking to share BGP debug logs; Redwood to verify prefix filters on transit gateway
   - Owner: Samir Patel (Orion) / Marcus Lee (Redwood)
   - Due: 2026-07-07 (critical)

2) Automated power-cycle failing on on-prem node-04 (blocking PXE reprovision)
   - Symptom: ipmitool returns "session timeout" intermittently; manual power-cycle works
   - Hypothesis: IPMI firmware bug + network ACL timing causing resets to drop
   - Temp: manual reboot by Orion infra until firmware patch applied
   - Owner: Lucia Gomez
   - Due: 2026-07-09 (firmware staging + validation)

3) HSM cert import delayed due to compliance review (medium)
   - Impact: can't enable KMS-backed secrets for DB encryption; will delay DB migration if not resolved
   - Action: Zoe to escalate with Orion security; provide required attestation docs
   - Owner: Zoe Park / Orion security (Samir)
   - Due: 2026-07-08

4) Helm chart KV persistence path mismatch (low)
   - Need to update chart to respect ORION_PERSIST_PATH env var; simple patch PR ready but needs release testing
   - Owner: Ethan Zhang
   - PR: GH #78 (linked)
   - Due: 2026-07-07 (merge + canary)

Action items (explicit)
- Samir: share BGP debug logs and current bgp.conf by 2026-07-07 (JIRA ORION-412)
- Marcus: verify transit gateway prefix filters and confirm NAT gateway egress rules; file runbook step if missing by 2026-07-07
- Lucia: reproduce IPMI timeout in staging, capture tcpdump, schedule firmware patch test by 2026-07-09
- Zoe: compile HSM attestation pack and coordinate cert import with Orion sec by 2026-07-08
- Ethan: finalize helm chart patch, get QA to run canary on staging, and open release PR by 2026-07-07
- All: update Confluence runbook with any new manual steps (file under /wiki/orion-deploy) - owner for runbook updates: Marcus

Risks / parking lot
- DB migration snapshot size larger than expected (oracle -> pg replica) - need to validate restore time in staging (TODO: schedule large restore test)
- Cost: temporary egress via NAT gateway increases cloud spend if cutover delayed
- Rollback plan needs a clear automated path; currently semi-manual (document gap)

Questions to raise with Orion next week
- Can Orion security expedite HSM cert import if we provide an attestation template? (Zoe to propose template)
- Do they have a windows of maintenance for full cutover (preferred nights: Thu/Fri)? If not, schedule ASAP

Notes to self / meeting prep reminders
- Bring the PR link and small demo of helm env var change (keep it <5 min)
- Have a list of fallback prefixes to request during BGP debug session
- Bring rough estimate of restore times (ask DB team for numbers before meeting)

Next meeting agenda (2026-07-13) - tentative
- 10m: Quick status + signoff on BGP fix
- 15m: Review firmware test outcome + plan for node reprovisioning
- 15m: HSM import status + decision on whether to proceed with software-encrypted staging migration
- 10m: Canary results & go/no-go for DB migration
- 10m: AOB and action item review

Meeting notes / follow-ups: keep this doc updated with final dates. If milestone 2 slips beyond 2026-07-10, we need to notify PM and adjust Dedicated capacity reservations.

---
Scratch notes (informal):
- If BGP fix takes >48h, schedule temporary packet capture session and escalate to network vendor (Cisco TAC)
- Consider short-lived VPN tunnel as temporary path if BGP instability persists (cost + perf tradeoff)
- Check with Billing if NAT egress costs are capped under current pilot credits

End of notes.
